Mapping Health and Aging in India: Early Findings from the BHARAT Study

Every dot is one of the 1,678 adults who have volunteered for our study so far, answered our questions and let us measure them.

Amruth D Bhat · Longevity India, IISc Bengaluru · Updated September 2026
Data: BHARAT Study (Longevity India, IISc Bengaluru), baseline visit, and a pilot plasma proteome of 80 participants. Analyses in R 4.5: mgcv GAMMs, PCA with Horn parallel analysis, PhenoAge (Levine 2018), limma, STRING v12, glmnet with nested cross-validation. Thresholds: ADA (HbA1c), WHO (anaemia 2024, ferritin 2020). Individual points are shown without identifiers, with age rounded to the year. In the opening figure, dot counts follow cohort totals and each dot's labels are assigned from cohort proportions for illustration. Map outline: official boundary of India (Survey of India, via DataMeet). Early findings, not peer reviewed.
